title: Loss Prevention Standard: Investigation Hold Share on Theft and Misuse Reports
content:
A Gift Cards & Store Credit card locked for a theft or misuse report carries an investigation hold share when it is replaced. The share depends on the lock reason and on whether the card was registered to the holder on or before the lock date, both shown on the card's record.

## Standard

| Lock reason | Card registered to the holder on or before the lock date | Investigation hold share |
|---|---|---|
| Reported stolen, or unauthorized use | No — never registered to the holder on or before the lock date | 0.40 |
| Reported stolen, or unauthorized use | Yes | 0.15 |
| Reported lost | Either | No investigation hold share |

## Registration date against lock date (hypothetical cards locked as reported stolen on 14 May)

| Registered to the holder | Share |
|---|---|
| 2 February | 0.15 |
| 14 May, the lock date itself | 0.15 |
| 15 May, after the lock | 0.40 |
| Never | 0.40 |

## Points of judgement

- **Lost against stolen:** the lock reason recorded on the card decides the line. A card locked as reported lost carries no investigation hold share whatever its registration.
- **Unauthorized use** is treated exactly as a theft report.
- **Registration after the lock** does not count; only registration on or before the lock date leads to the lower share.
